# UBC Unlimited — Merchant Services Utah
# https://ubcunlimited.com
# llms.txt — Machine-readable site summary for AI/LLM crawlers

## About
UBC Unlimited is a Utah-based merchant services company providing payment processing, POS systems, and credit card processing solutions to businesses across Utah. Led by Josh Cornia, UBC Unlimited offers local support, competitive rates, and fast onboarding for businesses of all sizes and risk profiles.

## Contact

## Core Services
- Credit card processing
- ACH & eCheck processing
- POS systems (SkyTab)
- eCommerce payments
- Mobile processing
- Virtual terminals
- Invoicing & recurring billing
- Gift & loyalty programs
- Cash discount & dual pricing
- High-risk merchant accounts
- Check guarantee

## Service Area
Utah, including Salt Lake City, Provo, Orem, Lehi, Ogden, St. George, and all Utah counties.

## Industries Served
Retail, restaurants, healthcare, automotive, e-commerce, high-risk, adult entertainment, nutraceuticals, online pharmacy, subscription/continuity, firearms, CBD/hemp, travel, and more.
